children: may retest resistance at $6,276 a metric ton, a break above which could lead to a gain to $6,405.
The fall from $6,825 could be well divided into five small waves, a structure suggesting a completion of the correction from this level.

The bounce from $6,025 defined a neutral zone between this level and the resistance at $6,276. Although the market is biased to test $6,276, trending signal will become clearer when it escapes from this zone.
